# Norway Spruce HD — provenance

Source: purchased CGTrader package `Realistic Spruce Trees`

Reference page:
`https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/plant/conifer/realistic-spruce-trees`

Classification: licensed third-party Phase 1 presentation content. This is not
donor-game content and is not newly authored project art. The original package
license and source terms continue to apply.

The source ZIP files remain unchanged outside the Unity project. The import
contains five FBX LOD levels for each variant. Project-owned wrapper prefabs and
HDRP materials are generated under
`Assets/Game/Presentation/Vegetation/Generated/Phase1`.

All variants deliberately share the healthy `Standard0` texture family and the
same restrained material tint. Geometry remains variant-specific while foliage
colour stays visually coherent across the generated forest.
